handoff_instructions: M2-T22 complete. Re-applied the previous run's wip patch (schema for lead_activities/retention_status already existed from earlier migrations, so no migration was needed): recordCallDisposition (packages/core/src/services/call-disposition.ts) now calls a new linkCallOutcomeToLeads (packages/core/src/services/leads.ts) after it updates the communication, only on the first (non-replay) processing of a call-ended event. It finds lead(s) with originating_communication_id = the ended call's communication, moves a lead's status from 'new' to 'contacted' (leaves any other status alone), inserts a lead_activities row (copying the communication's summary into `body` only while retention_status is 'active'; metadata always records disposition/duration/previous+new status/retention_status), and records a lead.call_outcome_linked event keyed on (lead.id, communication.id) for auditability. Added Communication.retentionStatus, LeadActivity type/toLeadActivity mapper, and the lead.call_outcome_linked event type to support this. Tests added in packages/core/test/call-disposition.test.ts cover: linking a tool-created lead with summary+disposition, replay linking nothing twice (lead_activities count stays 1, status stays contacted), retention_status past 'active' suppressing body copy, and a lead already past 'new' keeping its status. format:check/lint/typecheck/test all pass (packages/core: 324 passed, 7 pre-existing skips). Changes are staged but not committed. Next: reviewer should review the diff across the 6 changed files; no further build work identified for this task.
